reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-JP-20208-05-001: Same entrance does not combine postal and account services; retain separate papers, letter-only mailing, separate consultation and no assumed banking service conditions.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-JP-20208-06-001: Cracked card does not determine account status; no repeated ATM trials, own account not family card substitute, identity check and conditional replacement/interim access with no same-day guarantee.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-JP-20208-07-001: Home inventory differs from shopping list; unlisted does not imply shortage; family confirms only bread needed, milk/eggs not yet in basket, avoid duplicate purchases.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-JP-20208-08-001: Stamp-station numbers identify stations rather than compulsory order or distance; choose nearby3, usable paths, unchanged map IDs, separate walking-order note and shared route.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-JP-20209-01-001: Ambiguous connection refers to train transfer, not phone network; confirm next train name/location and actual itinerary before telling friend travel plans; no on-time arrival guarantee.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-JP-20209-02-001: Character reading differs from comprehension; short sentences plus examples without omitted conditions; required items then timing, personal application not copied from example circumstances.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-JP-20209-03-001: Patient masking lower-back discomfort to spare family worry; report actual symptoms and duration, request private conversation without blaming relatives, no assurance of room or substituting family reassurance.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-020-04-001: Pocket-size outdoor rain notebook; sturdy cover does not certify water-resistant paper; unavailable stock, reject unsuitable substitute, ask workplace product info without bag-waterproof guarantee.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-020-05-001: Native-language song introduced with personal family memory not full lyric translation; singing/introduction time separate, organizer confirms participation, no assumed acceptance.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-020-06-001: Unsealed apology letter to friend taken home for independent revision; friend difficulties not counter interlocutor, no staff judgment or rushed reply; content/seal/address checked before later mailing.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-020-07-001: Correct borrow to deposit own brought cash into own bankbook account; describe money movement, avoid unintended loan application, procedure only after service explanation.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-020-08-001: Bereaved visitor seeks calm resting place clear of passage, no ritual booking, phone put away, brief location contact to companion without hurry; gradual worship at own pace.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-020-09-001: Exhibition interest from family cheering memory rather than expertise; sliding athlete not named sport, equipment labels and pronunciation before personal notes, new learning shared with family.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-020-10-001: Personal faith means no worship gestures while companion participates; respect without prior agreement, separate waiting not anger, shared meeting place no hurry call.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-020-11-001: Police consultation notes in own language retained; chronological personal explanation, heard quotation distinct from own fear and unknown stranger intent, ask clarification rather than pretend all understood.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-020-12-001: Medicine bag washed in jacket; contents impact unknown despite drying exterior, unused since wash, separate explanatory sheet not guessed label, pharmacist handling confirmation before independent alteration/disposal.
reviewCriteria.SC-LOC-020-13-001: Self-made clothes for doll, traced buttonhole not doll-made premise; compare round and long shapes, only2 round blue buttons now, paper sample retrieved for real-clothes test before bulk purchase.
